lineage: NEW. Not a variant of EXP-ARP-008: the decision variable is a RATIO between two markets (ETH/BTC), used to rotate between BTC and a liquid alt basket.
mechanism_statement: Use the ETH/BTC cross-market ratio as a risk-appetite proxy: hold the equal-weight liquid alt basket when ETH/BTC trades above its own 50-day moving average, otherwise hold BTC. Rebalance weekly.

rules.holdings: risk_on -> equal-weight top-20 liquid non-BTC alts; risk_off -> BTCUSDT
rules.rebalance: weekly at UTC close; act next open; only rotate when the regime flips or basket membership changes
rules.position: one leg at a time (BTC or alt basket); fixed total notional 500 USD; no compounding

spec_contract.entry_rule: rotate weekly: hold alt basket if ETH/BTC > SMA50 else hold BTC; act next open
spec_contract.exit_rule: rotate on regime flip or basket membership change; act next open; no bar-close force

implementation_config.entry_rule: rotate weekly: hold alt basket if ETH/BTC > SMA50 else hold BTC; act next open
implementation_config.exit_rule: rotate on regime flip or basket membership change; act next open; no bar-close force
implementation_config.disposition: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — pre-registration only; no DEV execution in ARP-008

kill_criteria: DEV gross expectancy <= cost bps -> REJECT_COSTS
single trade > 50% of positive DEV net -> REJECT_FRAGILE

gates.promotion: positive net DEV AND positive net VALIDATION AND cost PASS AND robustness PASS AND PIT PASS AND contract PASS AND sample sufficient AND concentration acceptable AND builder != verifier
